name: note-links
description: Note ids (A-B32) in Claude's replies become links to the mcp-notes wall, and /open <id> opens a note in the browser from WSL.

wallUrl.title: Wall URL
wallUrl.description: Base URL of the mcp-notes wall, without a trailing slash. Left at the default, the URL is taken from `claude mcp get notes` when discovery is on.

discoverWallUrl.title: Find the wall from the notes MCP server
discoverWallUrl.description: At session start, read the notes server's URL from `claude mcp get notes` and use it (less /mcp) while Wall URL is left at its default.

linkifyReplies.title: Link note ids in replies
linkifyReplies.description: Redraw Claude's replies so every free-standing note id is a link to the wall. Off leaves only /open.
